caseName: Reese v. U. S. Board of Parole
caseNameFull: Reese v. U. S. Board of Parole

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. Motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and certiorari granted. Upon representation of the Solicitor General set forth in his memorandum for the United States filed February 20, 1974, judgment vacated and case remanded for further consideration in light of the position presently asserted by the Government.
